Bae Jun-ho.summary: Bae Jun-ho is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Stoke City who adds half-turn receiving, tight-space passing, and final-third invention.
Bae Jun-ho.note: Jun-ho is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For South Korea, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Bae Jun-ho.noteZh: 他给South Korea提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Cho Gue-sung.summary: Cho Gue-sung is a South Korea centre-forward from FC Midtjylland who gives the national team aerial presence, hold-up play, and penalty-box finishing.
Cho Gue-sung.note: Gue-sung is an attacking change-up for South Korea. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Cho Gue-sung.noteZh: 他是South Korea的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Cho Wi-je.summary: Cho Wi-je is a South Korea centre-back from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds size, man-marking, and aerial defending to the squad.
Cho Wi-je.note: Wi-je is back-line insurance for South Korea. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Cho Wi-je.noteZh: 他给South Korea那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Eom Ji-sung.summary: Eom Ji-sung is a South Korea winger from Swansea City who adds one-on-one dribbling, inside carries, and bench attacking tempo.
Eom Ji-sung.note: Ji-sung is the forward South Korea can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Eom Ji-sung.noteZh: 他给South Korea替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Hwang Hee-chan.summary: Hwang Hee-chan is a South Korea forward from Wolverhampton Wanderers who adds explosive pressing, channel running, and direct penalty-box threat.
Hwang Hee-chan.note: Hee-chan is the forward South Korea can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Hwang Hee-chan.noteZh: 他给South Korea替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Hwang In-beom.summary: Hwang In-beom is a South Korea midfielder from Feyenoord who gives the national team build-up passing, pressure resistance, and set-piece quality.
Hwang In-beom.note: In-beom has shown both sides of the attacking job for South Korea. One action can pull the defender, and the next one can decide the chance.
Hwang In-beom.noteZh: 他在这段征程中既进球也创造机会。同一次跑动，可能变成射门，也可能变成射门前的一脚传球。

Jens Castrop.summary: Jens Castrop is a South Korea central midfielder from Borussia Mönchengladbach who adds Bundesliga intensity, duel pressure, and two-way running.
Jens Castrop.note: Castrop gives South Korea a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Jens Castrop.noteZh: 他是South Korea的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Jo Hyeon-woo.summary: Jo Hyeon-woo is a South Korea goalkeeper from Ulsan HD who adds reflex saves, tournament experience, and command of the box.
Jo Hyeon-woo.note: Hyeon-woo sits behind the starter for South Korea, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Jo Hyeon-woo.noteZh: 他给South Korea保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Kim Jin-gyu.summary: Kim Jin-gyu is a South Korea central midfielder from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds simple circulation, late support, and domestic rhythm.
Kim Jin-gyu.note: Jin-gyu gives South Korea a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Kim Jin-gyu.noteZh: 他是South Korea的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Kim Min-jae.summary: Kim Min-jae is a South Korea centre-back from Bayern Munich who gives the national team elite defending, recovery speed, and line-breaking passes.
Kim Min-jae.note: Min-jae gives South Korea one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Kim Min-jae.noteZh: 他是South Korea无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Kim Moon-hwan.summary: Kim Moon-hwan is a South Korea right-back from Daejeon Hana Citizen who adds overlap timing, wide defending, and tournament experience.
Kim Moon-hwan.note: Moon-hwan is defensive cover for South Korea's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Kim Moon-hwan.noteZh: 他是South Korea在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Kim Seung-gyu.summary: Kim Seung-gyu is a South Korea goalkeeper from FC Tokyo who brings experience, distribution, and shot-stopping command.
Kim Seung-gyu.note: Seung-gyu has been South Korea's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Kim Seung-gyu.noteZh: 他给South Korea提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Kim Tae-hyeon.summary: Kim Tae-hyeon is a South Korea defender from Kashima Antlers who adds left-footed centre-back cover, recovery defending, and aerial strength.
Kim Tae-hyeon.note: Tae-hyeon gives South Korea cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Kim Tae-hyeon.noteZh: 他是South Korea后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Lee Dong-gyeong.summary: Lee Dong-gyeong is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Ulsan HD who adds left-footed passing, shooting range, and between-lines creativity.
Lee Dong-gyeong.note: Dong-gyeong gives South Korea midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Lee Dong-gyeong.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对South Korea来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Lee Gi-hyuk.summary: Lee Gi-hyuk is a South Korea defender from Gangwon FC who adds left-footed centre-back play, composure, and flexible build-up options.
Lee Gi-hyuk.note: Gi-hyuk gives South Korea one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Lee Gi-hyuk.noteZh: 他是South Korea无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Lee Han-beom.summary: Lee Han-beom is a South Korea centre-back from FC Midtjylland who adds European experience, aerial defending, and recovery power.
Lee Han-beom.note: Han-beom is in the quiet-work part of South Korea's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Lee Han-beom.noteZh: 他是South Korea主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Lee Jae-sung.summary: Lee Jae-sung is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Mainz 05 who adds pressing intelligence, link play, and late box arrivals.
Lee Jae-sung.note: Jae-sung gives South Korea midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Lee Jae-sung.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对South Korea来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Lee Kang-in.summary: Lee Kang-in is a South Korea attacking midfielder from Paris Saint-Germain who adds elite ball security, left-footed creation, and set-piece delivery.
Lee Kang-in.note: Kang-in has supplied one of South Korea's tournament goals. The pass matters because it arrives before the defender can fully turn.
Lee Kang-in.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经为South Korea创造过进球。注意他出球的时机，因为那一脚传球往往比带球更重要。

Lee Tae-seok.summary: Lee Tae-seok is a South Korea left-back from Austria Wien who adds width, crossing range, and progressive carries down the flank.
Lee Tae-seok.note: Tae-seok gives South Korea defensive range. His job is to make the opponent's first opening feel smaller than it looked.
Lee Tae-seok.noteZh: 他是South Korea在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Oh Hyeon-gyu.summary: Oh Hyeon-gyu is a South Korea centre-forward from Beşiktaş who adds strength, penalty-box movement, and direct finishing.
Oh Hyeon-gyu.note: Hyeon-gyu has already turned one tournament chance into a goal against Czechia. Watch whether defenders start giving him the extra step.
Oh Hyeon-gyu.noteZh: 他已经为South Korea进入这届世界杯的进球名单。一个终结会改变对手下一次防他的方式。

Paik Seung-ho.summary: Paik Seung-ho is a South Korea central midfielder from Birmingham City who adds deep passing, tempo control, and ball-winning balance.
Paik Seung-ho.note: Seung-ho is a tempo player for South Korea. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Paik Seung-ho.noteZh: 他让South Korea在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Park Jin-seob.summary: Park Jin-seob is a South Korea defensive midfielder from Zhejiang FC who adds screening, centre-back cover, and aerial bite.
Park Jin-seob.note: Jin-seob gives South Korea cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Park Jin-seob.noteZh: 他是South Korea后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Seol Young-woo.summary: Seol Young-woo is a South Korea right-back from Red Star Belgrade who adds two-sided full-back cover, recovery speed, and attacking support.
Seol Young-woo.note: Young-woo is in the quiet-work part of South Korea's setup. He keeps attacks from becoming scrambles.
Seol Young-woo.noteZh: 他是South Korea主要防守结构的一部分。他把第一下对抗处理干净，避免球队下一阶段只能追着球跑。

Son Heung-min.summary: Son Heung-min is South Korea's captain and Los Angeles FC forward, giving the national team elite movement, two-footed finishing, and transition threat.
Son Heung-min.note: Heung-min is one of South Korea's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Son Heung-min.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对South Korea来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Song Bum-keun.summary: Song Bum-keun is a South Korea goalkeeper from Jeonbuk Hyundai Motors who adds shot-stopping depth, size, and domestic rhythm.
Song Bum-keun.note: Bum-keun is South Korea's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Song Bum-keun.noteZh: 他是South Korea的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Yang Hyun-jun.summary: Yang Hyun-jun is a South Korea winger from Celtic who adds direct dribbling, right-side speed, and one-on-one pressure.
Yang Hyun-jun.note: Hyun-jun is an attacking change-up for South Korea. He gives the front line fresh running when the first plan starts to look predictable.
Yang Hyun-jun.noteZh: 他是South Korea的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。
